name: vga_dut

notes: TopMetal2 horizontal, TopMetal1 vertical, TopVia2 stitched 4 cut(s) per corner
ring width is set by the PDK minimum width, not by electromigration: 8.63 mA needs only 0.540 um of TopMetal2
cell name is vga_dut, shared with the schematic subcircuit
seven MOS arrays in one CTLE-style row, left to right: mdiode|pd1|ps1|tail1|tail2|ps2|pd2 (421.5 um bbox width, ~309 um active span)

two-row floorplan abandoned: horizontals at one row's drain y crossed another array's x; tightening ARRAY_GAP to ~5.97 um with Metal4 via stacks regressed DRC (Act.b/M2.b) and LVS (merged tails) with no saved intermediate
tail2, ps2 and pd2 mirror by device span not bounding box; vicm on Metal4 at y=49.5 um, separate from steerp/steern on Metal3
coils rotated to face each other, so vdd is one straight TopMetal2 strap with the nlp feeds below it dropping onto the loads
wire widths from the technology LEF at the operating point: 2.88 mA per tail, 8.63 mA supply
the coil pin row sits 54.0 um above the HBTs so the pwell-block markers clear their substrate ties
outputs leave at the top edge on Metal4 and inputs at the bottom on Metal4; vicm on Metal4, steerp and steern on Metal3 at the right edge, mgate on Metal4 at the left
ring squared about the axis at half-width 261.3 um and 10 um clearance
drawn nlp interconnect 102.6 um per side against the 0.00 fF budget in params.inc
permitted substitution(s): ind_shunt -> inductor; geometry for these is read from ind_shunt.inc rather than from the element line, and is still compared
